description.en: Used sine instead of tangent, as if this were Snell's law rather than Brewster's angle condition.
description.et: Kasutas siinust tangensi asemel, nagu kehtiks siin Snelli seadus, mitte Brewsteri nurga tingimus.

description.en: Divided n1 by the tangent instead of multiplying, inverting the relationship.
description.et: Jagas n1 tangensiga korrutamise asemel, pöörates seose ümber.

description.en: Passed the angle in degrees straight into tangent without converting to radians first.
description.et: Andis nurga kraadides otse tangensi sisse, teisendamata seda kõigepealt radiaanidesse.
